_readme: Tolerances and allowlists for scripts/verify-majors.js. Data, not code, so tuning is reviewable in a diff.
_universitywide: Courses that appear in sample plans but are satisfied through Universitywide/Experiential blocks the program pages link out to rather than list. Without these they read as unexplained on nearly every program.
_universitywidePatterns: Regex forms, applied to the same effect as the literal list. <SUBJ>1000 is the first-year seminar every college runs under its own subject code, EE**#### are the Experiential Learning courses, and <SUBJ>1990/2990 are transfer-credit placeholders. All appear in sample plans but are satisfied through Universitywide blocks the program pages link to rather than enumerate.
_planInSubject: A sample plan is an example, so a course in it that nothing requires may simply be a suggestion. Only unmatched courses in the program's OWN subjects are counted against it: a department filling a free-elective slot reaches for any subject, while a requirement we failed to read is almost always in-discipline. Red needs either 5+ such courses or a quarter of the plan — below that it is amber. Out-of-subject unmatched courses are info only. Safe because requirement-table-parity independently catches a genuinely dropped table and is graded high.
